title: Power outage schedules are forecasts, open to change, VECO official says

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – An official of the Visayan Electric Co. (VECO) clarified that its announced power interruption schedules on social media are forecasts and may change depending on real-time conditions in the power grid. VECO Marketing and Communications Manager Eric Monsanto said this after the Mandaue City Council urged the power distributor to follow its announced interruption schedules. The council had said that changes in the timing of outages affect the plans of residents and businesses. Monsanto explained that the grid situation is highly dynamic.
